records.rationale: The inner One Wilshire polygon is not a campus: its OSM history changed it from a commercial building to building:part=yes, and it carries the same 624 South Grand Avenue address, 30 levels, 120-meter height, and data-center use as the parent One Wilshire building. Preserve the source object as superseded and redirect it to the building facility.

evidence.finding: IM3 classified the smaller intersecting polygon as a campus and the enclosing One Wilshire footprint as a building.
OSM way 495115494 was retagged from building=commercial to building:part=yes in 2021 and now shares the parent building's exact address, height, levels, and data-center use.
The official building site identifies One Wilshire Building at 624 South Grand Avenue.

records.rationale: The intersecting objects are separate sites. OSM history identifies the Lumen building at 215 East Indian School Road and the campus boundary as building=no at 4010 North 3rd Street; 4010 Data Center independently identifies that address as its multi-building PHX02/PHX04 campus. Do not assign the Lumen building to the 4010 campus.

evidence.finding: IM3 supplied a partial geometry overlap between the Lumen building and an unnamed campus boundary.
OSM way histories preserve different addresses and identities: Lumen at 215 East Indian School Road and a non-building data-center boundary at 4010 North 3rd Street.
4010 Data Center identifies 4010 North 3rd Street as its own data-center site with multiple facility buildings.
